claim.value: Different records may have been copied from a common source.
claim.scope: A possible shared origin of records; actual copying is not asserted.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly identifies common-source copying as a possibility.

signal_basis.value: The operation checks for copied or derivative records and excludes them from independent corroboration; the positive signal requires independently originating records.
signal_basis.scope: Assessment of record independence, without asserting that copying was found in any particular case.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify the derivative-record check, the independence requirement, and the prospective status of the findings.
No conditional empirical warrant is required for this bounded possibility claim.

rationale: Records can share a source, so agreement alone need not provide independent corroboration. The mapping explicitly checks this possibility. The claim is licensed as a limitation and does not assert actual copying.
uncertainty: Whether any particular records were copied remains undetermined; that does not undermine the stated possibility.
